name: entities
title: game.entities
lead: The kinds of entity: `define` a pack's own, `amend` the game's own, and read a kind of the game: a mob kind by either spelling (`game.entities.cow`, `game.entities.Cow`), a kind that is not a mob by its name (`game.entities.arrow`); nil where the game has none. It iterates every kind, including pack definitions: `for name, kind in game.entities do`.

usedIn.quote: entity here: players are in `players`, never in `world.entities`. `game.entities.<kind>`
| Physics, gameplay hooks or persistence | `game.entities.define` and `world.spawn` | Gives a body behavior independent of its appearance. |
